entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Guess the drug was too strong...

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Wake him up.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: No dozing off.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: You still don't get it, do you?

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Give it up!

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: No strength left, huh?

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Say something!

entries.speaker: (SE)主人公
entries.en: Nngh... *cough*

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Come on, cooperate. Or what, you want another shot?

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Huh? What about the camera?

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Are you thinking it can be used as video evidence?
Of course not...
What do you mean...?

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: So you're not that dumb.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Which is good, 'cause we get to take as much time as we NEED!

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: You still haven't figured it out?

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: There are no laws here that will protect criminals like you!

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Didn't you hear my question? Answer!

entries.speaker: (SE)主人公
entries.en: *cough* Nngh! *wheeze*

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Obstruction of justice, blackmail,[n]defamation, possession of weapons...

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Manslaughter too, yeah? Talk about the works.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: To think that all those crimes were led by a punk like this...

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: And you seemed to be enjoying every second of it... Huh?
Yeah...
I don't remember...

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Good for you. It'll never happen[n]again.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: What!? You're the one who did it!

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: ...You should know your place.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Sign here.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: It's a confession under your name.
I understand...

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: I need your hand to sign this, but...

entries.speaker: (SE)主人公
entries.en: Urgh!

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: I don't care if you end up losing a leg.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: Don't expect to walk out of here in one piece.

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: We're going to make you understand...

entries.speaker: スーツの男A
entries.en: One must take full responsibility for their actions...
